What this part coversApa yang bahagian ini liputi

Heat conduction in a plate is the simplest two-dimensional field problem, and it carries every idea the rest of the course needs: a governing PDE, its boundary conditions, an element with shape functions, and the gradient of the interpolated field. Part 2 turns these into element matrices and a solved mesh.Heat conduction dalam plat ialah field problem dua dimensi yang paling mudah, dan ia membawa setiap idea yang diperlukan oleh baki kursus ini: PDE pentadbir, boundary condition-nya, element dengan shape function, dan gradient bagi field yang di-interpolate. Part 2 menukarkan semua ini kepada matrix element dan mesh yang diselesaikan.

After this part you should be able toSelepas bahagian ini, anda sepatutnya boleh

  1. Derive the steady 2D heat-conduction PDE from an energy balance and Fourier’s law, and write it as {∂}[E]{∂}ᵀT = −qh.Menerbitkan steady 2D heat-conduction PDE daripada energy balance dan Fourier’s law, dan menulisnya sebagai {∂}[E]{∂}ᵀT = −qh.
  2. Classify boundary conditions as Dirichlet (essential) or Neumann (natural) and write them for a rectangular domain.Mengelaskan boundary condition sebagai Dirichlet (essential) atau Neumann (natural) dan menulisnya untuk rectangular domain.
  3. Derive the bilinear shape functions N1…N4 of the four-node element and use them to interpolate T(x, y).Menerbitkan bilinear shape function N1…N4 bagi four-node element dan menggunakannya untuk interpolate T(x, y).
  4. Differentiate the approximation to obtain the temperature gradient and the heat flux at any point of an element.Membezakan approximation tersebut untuk mendapatkan temperature gradient dan heat flux pada mana-mana titik dalam element.

1. Why a 2D field problem, and what FEM deliversMengapa 2D field problem, dan apa yang FEM beri

≈ 6 min

Everything in the first half of the course was one-dimensional: a bar, a beam, a truss, a frame. The unknowns sat on a line. From here on the unknown is a field: a temperature T(x, y) defined at every point of a plate. We cannot solve for infinitely many values, so we solve for a finite number of them at nodes and let the element interpolate in between. That is the whole idea of the method.Semua yang kita buat pada separuh pertama kursus ini bersifat satu dimensi: bar, beam, truss, frame. Unknown terletak pada satu garis. Mulai sekarang unknown ialah satu field: temperature T(x, y) yang wujud pada setiap titik plat. Kita tidak mampu menyelesaikan nilai yang tak terhingga banyaknya, jadi kita selesaikan nilai pada node sahaja dan biarkan element membuat interpolation di antaranya. Itulah keseluruhan idea kaedah ini.

FEM is “nothing”, and FEM is “everything”FEM itu “tiada apa-apa”, dan FEM itu “segala-galanya”Nothing: FEM adds no new physics. It is only a way to turn a differential equation into simultaneous algebraic equations in matrix form. Everything: the same machinery solves heat, seepage, stress, vibration and fluid flow. Learn it once, on the simplest field problem, and reuse it.Tiada apa-apa: FEM tidak menambah fizik baharu. Ia hanya cara menukar differential equation kepada simultaneous algebraic equation dalam bentuk matrix. Segala-galanya: jentera yang sama menyelesaikan heat, seepage, stress, vibration dan fluid flow. Pelajari sekali pada field problem yang paling mudah, kemudian guna semula.

Scalar field first, vector field laterScalar field dahulu, vector field kemudian

Heat conduction is a scalar field problem: one unknown per node, the temperature T̂i. Plane stress, later in the course, is a vector field problem: two unknowns per node, the displacements ui and vi. Every idea of this part — shape functions, boundary conditions, assembly — appears in both; plane stress only has bigger matrices.Heat conduction ialah scalar field problem: satu unknown setiap node, iaitu temperature T̂i. Plane stress, kemudian dalam kursus ini, ialah vector field problem: dua unknown setiap node, iaitu displacement ui dan vi. Setiap idea dalam bahagian ini — shape function, boundary condition, assembly — muncul dalam kedua-duanya; plane stress cuma ada matrix yang lebih besar.

Where civil engineers meet conductionDi mana jurutera awam bertemu conduction

  • Mass concrete. Heat of hydration in dams, rafts and pile caps: the temperature rise and the gradient between core and surface drive early-age cracking.Mass concrete. Heat of hydration dalam empangan, raft dan pile cap: kenaikan temperature dan gradient antara teras dan permukaan menyebabkan early-age cracking.
  • Fire engineering. Temperature rise in steel sections and tunnel linings decides when strength is lost; the input is a 2D conduction model of the section.Fire engineering. Kenaikan temperature dalam keratan keluli dan tunnel lining menentukan bila kekuatan hilang; inputnya ialah model conduction 2D bagi keratan itu.
  • Pavements and decks. Daily thermal gradients through a bridge deck or a pavement slab produce stresses that design codes make us check.Pavement dan deck. Thermal gradient harian merentasi bridge deck atau pavement slab menghasilkan stress yang design code mewajibkan kita semak.
  • Ground and geothermal. Ground freezing, energy piles and buried pipelines are conduction problems in soil — and seepage uses the same equation.Tanah dan geothermal. Ground freezing, energy pile dan paip tertanam ialah masalah conduction dalam tanah — dan seepage menggunakan persamaan yang sama.
Key pointsPerkara utama
  • The unknown is a field T(x, y); FEM solves for nodal values and interpolates between them.Unknown ialah field T(x, y); FEM menyelesaikan nilai pada node dan interpolate di antaranya.
  • FEM adds no physics; it turns a PDE into [K]{T̂} = {r}.FEM tidak menambah fizik; ia menukar PDE kepada [K]{T̂} = {r}.
  • Scalar field: one unknown per node. Plane stress will have two.Scalar field: satu unknown setiap node. Plane stress akan ada dua.
Quick check · not gradedSemak cepat · tidak bergred

What does the finite element method add to the physics of heat conduction?Apa yang finite element method tambah kepada fizik heat conduction?

Nothing. The physics is the energy balance and Fourier’s law; FEM is a numerical method that turns the resulting PDE into algebraic equations.Tiada apa-apa. Fiziknya ialah energy balance dan Fourier’s law; FEM ialah kaedah berangka yang menukar PDE itu kepada algebraic equation.

2. From the energy balance to the PDEDaripada energy balance kepada PDE

≈ 10 min

Take a small rectangle dx by dy inside the plate, of unit thickness. The dependent variables are the heat fluxes qx and qy (W m−2): energy per unit time per unit area crossing a face. Heat enters through the near faces and leaves through the far faces.Ambil satu segi empat kecil dx × dy di dalam plat, dengan ketebalan unit. Dependent variable ialah heat flux qx dan qy (W m−2): tenaga per unit masa per unit luas yang melintasi satu muka. Haba masuk melalui muka dekat dan keluar melalui muka jauh.

The flux on the far face is the near-face flux plus its change across the element, a first-order Taylor expansion. The net inflow in the x-direction is thereforeFlux pada muka jauh ialah flux muka dekat ditambah perubahannya merentasi element, iaitu first-order Taylor expansion. and by the same argument in the y-directiondan dengan hujah yang sama dalam arah y

(2.3)

(2.5)

Conservation of energyConservation of energy

Rate of change of stored energy = net conduction in + heat generated. Every term carries the factor dx dy, the volume of the element per unit thickness, so it cancels:Kadar perubahan tenaga tersimpan = net conduction masuk + haba dijana. Setiap term membawa faktor dx dy, iaitu isi padu element per unit ketebalan, jadi ia terbatal:

(2.6)
Per unit thicknessPer unit ketebalanEvery quantity is multiplied by the same thickness t, which cancels, so we take t = 1. Nothing changes for a plate of any thickness as long as the faces are insulated.Setiap kuantiti didarab dengan ketebalan t yang sama, yang terbatal, jadi kita ambil t = 1. Tiada yang berubah untuk plat setebal mana pun selagi mukanya insulated.

Fourier’s law closes the systemFourier’s law melengkapkan sistem

The balance has three unknowns (T, qx, qy) and one equation. Fourier’s law supplies the other two: heat flows down the temperature gradient, in proportion to the conductivity k (W m−1 K−1). The minus sign is the physics: flux points from hot to cold.Balance ini ada tiga unknown (T, qx, qy) dan satu persamaan. Fourier’s law membekalkan dua lagi: haba mengalir menuruni temperature gradient, berkadar dengan conductivity k (W m−1 K−1). Tanda negatif itulah fiziknya: flux menghala dari panas ke sejuk.

(2.7)

Substituting (2.7) into the balance gives one equation in T alone:Menggantikan (2.7) ke dalam balance memberi satu persamaan dalam T sahaja:

(2.10)

Steady state: the PDE we discretiseSteady state: PDE yang kita discretise

Drop the time derivative. This is the equation you must be able to write from memory: the divergence of the flux equals the source.Gugurkan time derivative. Inilah persamaan yang anda mesti boleh tulis tanpa melihat nota: divergence bagi flux sama dengan source.

(2.11)

Two special cases you have met before: with constant isotropic k it is Poisson’s equation, and with no source it is Laplace’s equation — the same equation as potential flow in fluid mechanics and seepage in soil mechanics.Dua kes khas yang anda pernah temui: dengan k yang constant dan isotropic ia menjadi Poisson’s equation, dan tanpa source ia menjadi Laplace’s equation — persamaan yang sama dengan potential flow dalam mekanik bendalir dan seepage dalam mekanik tanah.

Unit checkSemakan unitEach term of (2.11) is W m−3: (W m−1 K−1)(K m−2). The source qh sits on the right with a minus sign because we moved it across; a positive source makes the field concave, a hill.Setiap term dalam (2.11) ialah W m−3: (W m−1 K−1)(K m−2). Source qh berada di kanan dengan tanda negatif kerana kita pindahkannya; source positif menjadikan field itu concave, seperti bukit.

The matrix form we will reuseBentuk matrix yang akan kita guna semula

Write the operator as a row of derivatives, a material matrix and a column of derivatives. This is the slide that pays off in plane stress, where the same pattern appears with a 3 × 3 [E] and a 2 × 3 operator.Tulis operator sebagai satu baris derivative, satu material matrix dan satu lajur derivative. Inilah bentuk yang membuahkan hasil dalam plane stress, apabila pola yang sama muncul dengan [E] 3 × 3 dan operator 2 × 3.

Order mattersSusunan penting{∂} is a row of operators, not numbers: it acts on whatever stands to its right. You cannot commute it past a function.{∂} ialah satu baris operator, bukan nombor: ia bertindak ke atas apa sahaja di sebelah kanannya. Anda tidak boleh menukar susunannya melepasi sesuatu fungsi.

Worked step · the y-direction balance (Activity 2)Langkah bekerja · balance arah y (Aktiviti 2)

In through y = 0: qy dx. Out through y = dy: (qy + ∂qy/∂y dy) dx. Net inflow Qy = −∂qy/∂y dx dy, equation (2.3). Add Qx, Qy and Qh, set the sum equal to the stored-energy rate QE, cancel dx dy, and (2.6) follows.Masuk melalui y = 0: qy dx. Keluar melalui y = dy: (qy + ∂qy/∂y dy) dx. Net inflow Qy = −∂qy/∂y dx dy, persamaan (2.3). Tambah Qx, Qy dan Qh, samakan hasil tambahnya dengan kadar tenaga tersimpan QE, batalkan dx dy, dan (2.6) terhasil.

What are the units of the heat-generation term qh in (2.11)?Apakah unit bagi term heat generation qh dalam (2.11)?

qh is heat generated per unit volume, W m−3, the same as k ∂²T/∂x². A flux (W m−2) is per unit area; conductivity is W m−1 K−1.qh ialah haba dijana per unit isi padu, W m−3, sama dengan k ∂²T/∂x². Flux (W m−2) ialah per unit luas; conductivity ialah W m−1 K−1.

3. Boundary conditions: essential and naturalBoundary condition: essential dan natural

≈ 7 min

A PDE alone is not a problem. On every part of the boundary we must specify either the temperature or the flux. There are only two kinds of condition, and the whole of the finite element treatment depends on telling them apart.PDE sahaja bukan satu masalah. Pada setiap bahagian sempadan kita mesti tetapkan sama ada temperature atau flux. Hanya ada dua jenis condition, dan keseluruhan rawatan finite element bergantung pada kebolehan membezakannya.

(2.16)
(2.15)
Dirichlet, or essentialDirichlet, atau essentialThe temperature T̄ is known on the edge. FEM must impose it on the unknowns: the corresponding rows and columns of the assembled system are modified.Temperature T̄ diketahui pada tepi itu. FEM mesti mengenakannya pada unknown: baris dan lajur yang sepadan dalam assembled system diubah suai.
Neumann, or naturalNeumann, atau naturalThe boundary flux qb is known, positive inward, and enters through the outward unit normal n = (nx, ny). FEM does not impose it: it appears by itself as a load, from the integration by parts in Part 2.Boundary flux qb diketahui, positif ke dalam, dan masuk melalui outward unit normal n = (nx, ny). FEM tidak mengenakannya: ia muncul dengan sendirinya sebagai load, daripada integration by parts dalam Part 2.

Rectangular domainsRectangular domain

An insulated edge is a natural condition with qb = 0, so the boundary term {b} it would produce is zero. No action is needed.Tepi insulated ialah natural condition dengan qb = 0, jadi boundary term {b} yang bakal dihasilkannya ialah sifar. Tiada tindakan diperlukan.

4. The four-node element and its shape functionsFour-node element dan shape function-nya

≈ 12 min

The four-node rectangular element has one degree of freedom at each corner, the temperature T̂i, numbered anticlockwise from the bottom-left corner. We need a rule for T at any point inside the element in terms of these four numbers. The rule is a polynomial with four coefficients.Four-node rectangular element mempunyai satu degree of freedom pada setiap bucu, iaitu temperature T̂i, dinomborkan lawan jam dari bucu kiri bawah. Kita perlukan satu peraturan bagi T pada mana-mana titik di dalam element dalam sebutan empat nombor ini. Peraturannya ialah satu polynomial dengan empat coefficient.

Step 1 · assume a polynomial (2.17)Langkah 1 · andaikan satu polynomial (2.17)

(2.17)

Four unknowns need four coefficients. The xy term, rather than x² or y², keeps the function linear along every edge, which is what makes neighbouring elements agree.Empat unknown memerlukan empat coefficient. Term xy, bukannya x² atau y², mengekalkan fungsi itu linear di sepanjang setiap tepi, dan itulah yang membuat element berjiran bersetuju.

Step 2 · evaluate at the nodes (2.18)Langkah 2 · nilaikan pada node (2.18)

(2.18)

Step 3 · solve for the coefficients (2.19)Langkah 3 · selesaikan coefficient (2.19)

(2.19)

Check: if all four nodal values are equal to T0, then a1 = T0 and a2 = a3 = a4 = 0, so T = T0 everywhere. A uniform field is reproduced exactly.Semak: jika keempat-empat nilai node sama dengan T0, maka a1 = T0 dan a2 = a3 = a4 = 0, jadi T = T0 di mana-mana. Field yang seragam dihasilkan semula dengan tepat.

Step 4 · collect by nodal value (2.20)–(2.22)Langkah 4 · kumpulkan mengikut nilai node (2.20)–(2.22)

(2.20)
(2.21)
(2.22)

Each nodal value is multiplied by its own function of position: its shape function Ni(x, y). The row {N} and the column {T̂}ᵀ are the two objects the rest of the course is built from.Setiap nilai node didarab dengan fungsi kedudukannya sendiri: shape function Ni(x, y). Baris {N} dan lajur {T̂}ᵀ ialah dua objek yang menjadi asas keseluruhan kursus ini.

What a shape function looks likeRupa sebuah shape function

Three properties you can check in 30 secondsTiga sifat yang boleh disemak dalam 30 saat

Kronecker delta. So T at node j equals T̂j: the nodal unknowns really are nodal temperatures. Check N2 at node 3: N2(a, b) = a(b − b)/(ab) = 0.Kronecker delta. Jadi T pada node j sama dengan T̂j: nodal unknown memang temperature pada node. Semak N2 pada node 3: N2(a, b) = a(b − b)/(ab) = 0.

Partition of unity. A uniform temperature is reproduced exactly, the test we did on the coefficients.Partition of unity. Temperature yang seragam dihasilkan semula dengan tepat, ujian yang kita buat pada coefficient tadi.

Linear along each edge. On y = 0 only nodes 1 and 2 matter, and T varies linearly between them. The neighbouring element shares those two nodes and the same straight line, so T is continuous across element boundaries (C0).Linear di sepanjang setiap tepi. Pada y = 0 hanya node 1 dan 2 yang penting, dan T berubah secara linear antara keduanya. Element berjiran berkongsi dua node itu dan garis lurus yang sama, jadi T adalah continuous merentasi sempadan element (C0).

From one element to the meshDaripada satu element kepada mesh

a = 2 m, b = 1 m, point (x, y) = (1.5, 0.3) m, nodal temperatures T̂ = {100, 140, 160, 120} K.a = 2 m, b = 1 m, titik (x, y) = (1.5, 0.3) m, nodal temperature T̂ = {100, 140, 160, 120} K.

Node 2 carries half the weight because the point is nearest to it. The sum of the four weights is 1, as it must be.Node 2 membawa separuh daripada weight kerana titik itu paling hampir dengannya. Hasil tambah empat weight ialah 1, sebagaimana sepatutnya.

5. Gradient and flux inside an elementGradient dan flux di dalam element

≈ 7 min

Differentiate the approximation T = {N}{T̂}ᵀ and the derivatives land on the shape functions, because the nodal values are constants. The gradient at any point is a 2 × 4 matrix of shape-function derivatives times the nodal vector:Bezakan approximation T = {N}{T̂}ᵀ dan derivative itu jatuh pada shape function, kerana nilai node ialah pemalar. Gradient pada mana-mana titik ialah matrix 2 × 4 bagi derivative shape function didarab dengan nodal vector:

(2.33)

Read the matrix: ∂Ni/∂x depends on y only and ∂Ni/∂y on x only. Across an element edge the gradient, and therefore the flux, generally jumps — the approximation is continuous but its derivative is not.Baca matrix itu: ∂Ni/∂x bergantung pada y sahaja dan ∂Ni/∂y pada x sahaja. Merentasi tepi element, gradient dan seterusnya flux biasanya melompat — approximation itu continuous tetapi derivative-nya tidak.

From gradient to fluxDaripada gradient kepada flux

Fourier’s law in matrix form: flux = −[E] × gradient. The same 2 × 4 matrix {∂}ᵀ{N} will be used twice: for the flux now, and for the conductance matrix in Part 2:Fourier’s law dalam bentuk matrix: flux = −[E] × gradient. Matrix 2 × 4 yang sama, {∂}ᵀ{N}, akan digunakan dua kali: untuk flux sekarang, dan untuk conductance matrix dalam Part 2:

Worked example · gradient and flux at (1.5, 0.3) (Activity 5)Contoh bekerja · gradient dan flux pada (1.5, 0.3) (Aktiviti 5)

Same element and data as Activity 4, with kx = ky = 2 W m−1 K−1.Element dan data yang sama dengan Aktiviti 4, dengan kx = ky = 2 W m−1 K−1.

Both components of the flux are negative: heat flows towards decreasing x and y, away from the hottest node 3 at (a, b).Kedua-dua komponen flux negatif: haba mengalir ke arah x dan y yang menyusut, menjauhi node 3 yang paling panas di (a, b).

The eight-node element in one paragraphEight-node element dalam satu perenggan

Add a node at the middle of each edge and the polynomial gains four terms, (2.31). The shape functions are quadratic along each edge, so they follow a curved temperature profile with fewer elements. The procedure is identical: evaluate at the eight nodes, invert, collect by nodal value. A corner function now dips below zero between its two mid-side neighbours, and the eight functions still sum to one.Tambah satu node di tengah setiap tepi dan polynomial itu mendapat empat term lagi, (2.31). Shape function-nya quadratic di sepanjang setiap tepi, jadi ia mengikut profil temperature yang melengkung dengan element yang lebih sedikit. Prosedurnya serupa: nilaikan pada lapan node, inverse, kumpulkan mengikut nilai node. Fungsi bucu kini jatuh di bawah sifar antara dua jiran tengah sisinya, dan lapan fungsi itu tetap berjumlah satu.

(2.31)

Square plate 1 m × 1 m, qh = 600 W m−3, kx = ky = 300 W m−1 K−1; top and left edges at 0 °C, right and bottom edges insulated. Before Part 2Sebelum Part 2Classify its four edges as in §3 and predict where the hottest point is. Write the prediction down; Part 2 checks it.Kelaskan empat tepinya seperti dalam §3 dan ramalkan di mana titik paling panas. Tulis ramalan itu; Part 2 menyemaknya.

The MATLAB skeleton follows the pipelineRangka MATLAB mengikut pipeline

% Local conductance matrix (text §2.3.1)
a = L/Nx; b = H/Ny;
s1 = b*kx/(3*a) + a*ky/(3*b);
s2 = -b*kx/(3*a) + a*ky/(6*b);
s3 = -b*kx/(6*a) - a*ky/(6*b);
s4 = b*kx/(6*a) - a*ky/(3*b);
k = [s1 s2 s3 s4; s2 s1 s4 s3; s3 s4 s1 s2; s4 s3 s2 s1];
fQ = a*b*Q/4*[1; 1; 1; 1];        % heat generation
% Assembly by connectivity, element 1 = nodes [1 2 5 4]
e1 = [1 2 5 4];  K(e1,e1) = K(e1,e1) + k;  F(e1) = F(e1) + fQ;
% Essential conditions: rows and columns of known nodes removed
free = setdiff(1:n, fixed);  T = zeros(n,1);  T(fixed) = Tbar;
T(free) = K(free,free) \ (F(free) - K(free,fixed)*T(fixed));
  • Lines 2–8: step 5, the element matrix and load from closed-form integrals (s1…s4 are derived in Part 2).Baris 2–8: langkah 5, matrix element dan load daripada closed-form integral (s1…s4 diterbitkan dalam Part 2).
  • Line 10: step 6, assembly — the connectivity list [1 2 5 4] is the element’s global node numbers.Baris 10: langkah 6, assembly — senarai connectivity [1 2 5 4] ialah nombor node global bagi element itu.
  • Lines 12–13: step 6, essential conditions by removing the rows and columns of the known nodes; step 7, solve with the backslash operator.Baris 12–13: langkah 6, essential condition dengan membuang baris dan lajur node yang diketahui; langkah 7, selesaikan dengan operator backslash.

Example 1 · Shape functions and conductance matrix of a triangleContoh 1 · Shape function dan conductance matrix bagi segi tiga

Exam typeJenis soalan derive N1, N2, N3 from T = a1 + a2x + a3y, then [k]UnitsUnit symbolicSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 8.120 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanA three-node heat element has its nodes at (0, 0), (L, 0) and (L/2, L). With the interpolation T(x, y) = a1 + a2x + a3y, (a) derive the shape functions by writing T = N1T1 + N2T2 + N3T3, (b) check them, and (c) find the conductance matrix for kx = ky = k and thickness t.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. A plane over a triangle is fixed by its three corner values, so the three nodal temperatures determine a1, a2 and a3. Each shape function is the field obtained with its own node at 1 and the other two at 0: a plane that is 1 at that node and 0 along the opposite side. Side 1–2 lies on y = 0, so N3 must depend on y only.Satah di atas segi tiga ditentukan oleh tiga nilai bucunya, jadi tiga nodal temperature menentukan a1, a2 dan a3. Setiap shape function ialah field yang diperoleh dengan node sendiri bernilai 1 dan dua node lain 0: satah yang bernilai 1 pada node itu dan 0 di sepanjang sisi bertentangan. Sisi 1–2 terletak pada y = 0, jadi N3 mesti bergantung pada y sahaja.

Plan. Three nodal conditions → a1, a2, a3 → collect T1, T2, T3 → checks → derivatives → [k].

Step 1 Nodal conditionsNodal condition[3]

Step 2 (a) The coefficients(a) Coefficient[3]

From the first two, a1 = T1 and a2 = (T2 − T1)/L. The third then givesDaripada dua yang pertama, a1 = T1 dan a2 = (T2 − T1)/L. Yang ketiga kemudian memberi

Step 3 Collecting the nodal temperaturesMengumpul nodal temperature[2]

Answer. (a)

Step 4 (b) Checks(b) Semakan[3]

Nodes 1 and 2 check in the same way. At the centroid (L/2, L/3) each function is 1/3.Node 1 dan 2 disemak dengan cara yang sama. Pada centroid (L/2, L/3) setiap fungsi bernilai 1/3.

Answer. (b) Ni = 1 at node i and 0 at the others; ΣNi = 1 everywhere.

Step 5 (c) Derivatives and [k](c) Derivative dan [k][9]

The derivatives are constant, so the integral kij = t∫(kx Ni,xNj,x + ky Ni,yNj,y) dA is the area times the integrand (the conductance matrix of Part 2):Derivative itu pemalar, jadi integral kij = t∫(kx Ni,xNj,x + ky Ni,yNj,y) dA ialah luas didarab integrand (conductance matrix dalam Part 2):

Answer. (c)
each row adds up to zero.

Check. Row 1: 5 − 3 − 2 = 0; row 3: −2 − 2 + 4 = 0. [k] is symmetric.

InterpretationTafsiran[k] does not contain L. Each entry is the thickness times the area, which grows as L², times a product of two gradients, each of which falls as 1/L; the two effects cancel, so a triangle of the same shape conducts the same heat per kelvin whatever its size. Every row adds up to zero because a uniform temperature, T1 = T2 = T3, produces no heat flow. The temperature inside the element is a plane, so its gradient, and with it the heat flux, is constant in each element and jumps from one element to the next; the temperature itself stays continuous, since along a shared side it varies linearly between the same two nodal values.[k] tidak mengandungi L. Setiap entri ialah ketebalan didarab luas, yang membesar sebagai L², didarab hasil darab dua gradient yang masing-masing menyusut sebagai 1/L; dua kesan itu saling membatalkan, jadi segi tiga dengan bentuk yang sama mengalirkan haba yang sama per kelvin tanpa mengira saiznya. Setiap baris berjumlah sifar kerana temperature seragam, T1 = T2 = T3, tidak menghasilkan aliran haba. Temperature di dalam element ialah satah, jadi gradient-nya, dan seterusnya heat flux, adalah pemalar dalam setiap element dan melompat dari satu element ke element seterusnya; temperature itu sendiri kekal continuous, kerana di sepanjang sisi yang dikongsi ia berubah secara linear antara dua nilai node yang sama.

Example 2 · Temperature and flux at a point of a four-node elementContoh 2 · Temperature dan flux pada satu titik four-node element

Exam typeJenis soalan T(x, y), ∂T/∂x, ∂T/∂y and q from nodal temperaturesUnitsUnit m, °C, WSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Practice Problem 8.3 (worked in full here)20 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanA four-node element 0.4 m by 0.3 m has nodal temperatures 20, 40, 60 and 30 °C at nodes 1 to 4 (anticlockwise from the origin), and k = 15 W m−1 K−1. Find T, qx and qy (a) at the centre and (b) at the local point (0.1, 0.2) m.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. The nodal values rise from node 1 to node 3, so the temperature increases in both +x and +y; Fourier’s law then makes both flux components negative, pointing back towards node 1. The gradient of a bilinear field is not constant: ∂T/∂x changes with y and ∂T/∂y with x, so the two points will give different fluxes.Nilai node meningkat dari node 1 ke node 3, jadi temperature bertambah dalam arah +x dan +y; Fourier’s law kemudian menjadikan kedua-dua komponen flux negatif, menghala kembali ke node 1. Gradient bagi field bilinear tidak malar: ∂T/∂x berubah dengan y dan ∂T/∂y dengan x, jadi dua titik itu akan memberi flux yang berbeza.

Plan. Ni at the point → T = ΣNiTi → ∂Ni/∂x, ∂Ni/∂y from (2.33) → gradient → q = −k∇T. ab = 0.4 × 0.3 = 0.12 m² throughout.

Step 1 (a) Shape functions and T at the centre(a) Shape function dan T pada pusat[4]

Step 2 (a) Derivatives at the centre (y = 0.15, x = 0.2)(a) Derivative pada pusat (y = 0.15, x = 0.2)[3]

Step 3 (a) Gradient and flux at the centre(a) Gradient dan flux pada pusat[3]

Answer. (a) T = 37.5 °C; qx = −938 W m−2, qy = −750 W m−2.

Check. ΣNi = 1. Both fluxes negative, as the physical picture predicted.

Step 4 (b) Shape functions and T at (0.1, 0.2)(b) Shape function dan T pada (0.1, 0.2)[5]

With a − x = 0.3 and b − y = 0.1:Dengan a − x = 0.3 dan b − y = 0.1:

Step 5 (b) Gradient and flux at (0.1, 0.2)(b) Gradient dan flux pada (0.1, 0.2)[5]

Answer. (b) T = 33.3 °C; qx = −1000 W m−2, qy = −625 W m−2.
InterpretationTafsiranThe gradient changes between the two points because T1 − T2 + T3 − T4 = 20 − 40 + 60 − 30 = 10 ≠ 0: that combination is the coefficient a4 of the xy term, and it is the only reason the field is not a plane. With four values that sum to zero in that pattern the flux would be the same everywhere in the element. The numbers also show the sign convention at work: a flux is negative when the temperature increases in that direction.Gradient berubah antara dua titik itu kerana T1 − T2 + T3 − T4 = 20 − 40 + 60 − 30 = 10 ≠ 0: gabungan itu ialah coefficient a4 bagi term xy, dan itulah satu-satunya sebab field itu bukan satah. Dengan empat nilai yang berjumlah sifar dalam pola itu, flux akan sama di seluruh element. Nombor-nombor itu juga menunjukkan tanda yang digunakan: flux negatif apabila temperature meningkat dalam arah itu.

Example 3 · Explain-type questions: model answersContoh 3 · Soalan jenis terangkan: jawapan model

Exam typeJenis soalan explain, three sentences each: claim, reason, consequenceSourceSumber FEM by Hand, §8.44 × 3 = 12 marksmarkah
QuestionsSoalanAnswer each in two or three sentences. State the claim, give the reason, and say what follows from it.Jawab setiap satu dalam dua atau tiga ayat. Nyatakan dakwaan, beri sebab, dan nyatakan apa yang terhasil daripadanya.

Step 1 Why is nothing done at an insulated edge?Mengapa tiada apa-apa dibuat pada tepi insulated?[3]

An insulated edge is a natural condition with qn = 0, so its boundary term t∫{N}qn ds is zero. The Galerkin formulation satisfies it approximately without any action. A non-zero flux would instead enter {r} at the nodes of that edge.Tepi insulated ialah natural condition dengan qn = 0, jadi boundary term-nya t∫{N}qn ds ialah sifar. Formulasi Galerkin memenuhinya secara anggaran tanpa sebarang tindakan. Flux bukan sifar pula akan masuk ke {r} pada node tepi itu.

Step 2 What is the difference between an essential and a natural boundary condition, and how is each imposed?Apakah perbezaan antara essential dan natural boundary condition, dan bagaimana setiap satu dikenakan?[3]

An essential condition prescribes the primary variable, the temperature T = T̄; a natural condition prescribes the secondary variable, the flux qn. The essential condition is imposed on the assembled equations by striking the rows and columns of the known nodes, and the struck rows later give the heat flows there. The natural condition is never imposed: it appears by itself as a load through the boundary term of the integration by parts.Essential condition menetapkan primary variable, iaitu temperature T = T̄; natural condition menetapkan secondary variable, iaitu flux qn. Essential condition dikenakan pada assembled equation dengan membuang baris dan lajur node yang diketahui, dan baris yang dibuang itu kemudian memberi aliran haba di situ. Natural condition tidak pernah dikenakan: ia muncul dengan sendirinya sebagai load melalui boundary term daripada integration by parts.

Step 3 Why does every row of [k] add up to zero, and how is that used?Mengapa setiap baris [k] berjumlah sifar, dan bagaimana ia digunakan?[3]

Since ΣNi = 1, a uniform temperature makes every gradient zero and conducts no heat, so [k]{1, 1, …}ᵀ = {0}. Consequently [k], and an unrestrained [K], are singular, which is why at least one temperature must be prescribed. Every row of a computed matrix can be checked in a few seconds by adding it up.

Oleh kerana ΣNi = 1, temperature seragam menjadikan setiap gradient sifar dan tidak mengalirkan haba, jadi [k]{1, 1, …}ᵀ = {0}. Akibatnya [k], dan [K] yang tidak dikekang, adalah singular; sebab itulah sekurang-kurangnya satu temperature mesti ditetapkan. Setiap baris matrix yang dikira boleh disemak dalam beberapa saat dengan menjumlahkannya.

Step 4 How do the three-node and the four-node elements differ?Bagaimana three-node dan four-node element berbeza?[3]

The T3 field is a plane, so its gradient and flux are constant in each element. The Q4 field contains xy, so ∂T/∂x varies with y and ∂T/∂y with x. Both fields vary linearly along every side, so the temperature is continuous between elements while the flux jumps; on the same nodes the Q4 is usually more accurate, but in this course it is limited to rectangles, whereas triangles fit any shape.Field T3 ialah satah, jadi gradient dan flux-nya malar dalam setiap element. Field Q4 mengandungi xy, jadi ∂T/∂x berubah dengan y dan ∂T/∂y dengan x. Kedua-dua field berubah secara linear di sepanjang setiap sisi, jadi temperature continuous antara element manakala flux melompat; pada node yang sama Q4 biasanya lebih tepat, tetapi dalam kursus ini ia terhad kepada segi empat tepat, manakala segi tiga sesuai untuk apa jua bentuk.

InterpretationTafsiranThe examiner looks for the three parts in order. “Insulated means do nothing” alone is a claim without a reason and earns one mark of three; naming the boundary term and its value earns the other two.Pemeriksa mencari tiga bahagian mengikut urutan. “Insulated bermaksud tiada tindakan” sahaja ialah dakwaan tanpa sebab dan mendapat satu daripada tiga markah; menamakan boundary term dan nilainya mendapat dua markah lagi.

A1 · 1 markmarkah
In the steady conduction equation (2.11), which combination has the units of qh?Dalam persamaan steady conduction (2.11), gabungan manakah yang mempunyai unit qh?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

k ∂²T/∂x² has units (W m−1 K−1)(K m−2) = W m−3, the same as qh. The option k ∂T/∂x is a flux, W m−2.k ∂²T/∂x² berunit (W m−1 K−1)(K m−2) = W m−3, sama dengan qh. Pilihan k ∂T/∂x ialah flux, W m−2.

A2 · 1 markmarkah
Which boundary condition must be imposed on the assembled equations rather than appearing by itself?Boundary condition manakah yang mesti dikenakan pada assembled equation dan bukannya muncul dengan sendiri?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

A known temperature is an essential (Dirichlet) condition: it constrains the unknowns themselves. A known flux, including zero flux, is natural and comes out of the integration by parts.Temperature yang diketahui ialah essential (Dirichlet) condition: ia mengekang unknown itu sendiri. Flux yang diketahui, termasuk flux sifar, adalah natural dan terhasil daripada integration by parts.

A3 · 1 markmarkah
On the right edge of a plate, n = (1, 0), an inward flux qb = +500 W m−2 is applied. The flux-vector component qx at that edge isPada tepi kanan plat, n = (1, 0), flux ke dalam qb = +500 W m−2 dikenakan. Komponen flux-vector qx pada tepi itu ialah

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

qb is positive inward. On the right edge, inward means towards −x, so qx = −qb = −500 W m−2. Equivalently (2.15): k ∂T/∂x · nx = qb, so k ∂T/∂x = +500 and qx = −k ∂T/∂x = −500.qb positif ke dalam. Pada tepi kanan, ke dalam bermaksud ke arah −x, jadi qx = −qb = −500 W m−2. Setara dengan (2.15): k ∂T/∂x · nx = qb, jadi k ∂T/∂x = +500 dan qx = −k ∂T/∂x = −500.

A4 · 1 markmarkah
Why is the fourth term of the polynomial (2.17) chosen as xy rather than x²?Mengapa term keempat polynomial (2.17) dipilih sebagai xy dan bukannya x²?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

With xy, setting y = 0 (or x = 0, or y = b, or x = a) leaves a function that is linear in the remaining coordinate, fixed by the two nodes of that edge. Two elements sharing the edge share those nodes, so T is continuous. An x² term would make T along an edge depend on more than its two nodes.Dengan xy, menetapkan y = 0 (atau x = 0, y = b, x = a) meninggalkan fungsi yang linear dalam koordinat yang tinggal, ditentukan oleh dua node tepi itu. Dua element yang berkongsi tepi berkongsi node itu, jadi T continuous. Term x² akan menjadikan T sepanjang tepi bergantung pada lebih daripada dua node.

A5 · 1 markmarkah
The four nodal temperatures of an element are all 250 K. At a point inside the element, T isKeempat-empat nodal temperature sebuah element ialah 250 K. Pada satu titik di dalam element, T ialah

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Partition of unity: Σ Ni = 1 everywhere, so T = 250 × Σ Ni = 250 K at every point. A uniform field is reproduced exactly.Partition of unity: Σ Ni = 1 di mana-mana, jadi T = 250 × Σ Ni = 250 K pada setiap titik. Field yang seragam dihasilkan semula dengan tepat.

A6 · 1 markmarkah
Inside a four-node element, ∂T/∂x of the interpolated fieldDi dalam four-node element, ∂T/∂x bagi field yang di-interpolate

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

From (2.17), ∂T/∂x = a2 + a4 y: it depends on y only. Equivalently, every ∂Ni/∂x in the 2 × 4 matrix contains (b − y) or y.Daripada (2.17), ∂T/∂x = a2 + a4 y: ia bergantung pada y sahaja. Setara, setiap ∂Ni/∂x dalam matrix 2 × 4 mengandungi (b − y) atau y.

C1 · 2 marksmarkah
A student evaluates the shape functions at (x, y) = (0.5, 0.8) m in a 2 m × 1 m element and interpolates T from T̂ = {100, 140, 160, 120} K. One line contains the slip. Which one?Seorang pelajar menilai shape function pada (x, y) = (0.5, 0.8) m dalam element 2 m × 1 m dan interpolate T daripada T̂ = {100, 140, 160, 120} K. Satu baris mengandungi kesilapan. Yang mana?

Before you answer:Sebelum menjawab:

Line 4: N4 = y(a − x)/(ab) = (0.8)(1.5)/2 = 0.60, not x(a − y)/(ab). The check that should have caught it: the four values must sum to 1, and 0.15 + 0.05 + 0.20 + 0.30 = 0.70. With N4 = 0.60 the sum is 1.00 and T = 15 + 7 + 32 + 72 = 126.0 K.Baris 4: N4 = y(a − x)/(ab) = (0.8)(1.5)/2 = 0.60, bukan x(a − y)/(ab). Semakan yang sepatutnya menangkapnya: empat nilai mesti berjumlah 1, dan 0.15 + 0.05 + 0.20 + 0.30 = 0.70. Dengan N4 = 0.60 jumlahnya 1.00 dan T = 15 + 7 + 32 + 72 = 126.0 K.

Show the codeTunjuk kod · fe_shape_functions.py · 188 linesbaris
"""
SEAA 4243 Finite Element Method - shape functions of the rectangular elements
==============================================================================

Companion code for the Shape Function Explorer (2D Heat Transfer, Part 1).

What it does
    Evaluates the shape functions N_i of the 4-node (Q4) and 8-node (Q8)
    rectangular elements at a point, checks them, interpolates a nodal field,
    and computes the gradient and the heat flux at that point.

Notation (text: Mohd Yassin et al., MSNM 2020, Sec. 2.2)
    Element a x b. Local nodes 1-4 anticlockwise from the bottom-left corner;
    the Q8 adds mid-side nodes 5-8 on the bottom, right, top and left sides.
    Local coordinates x in [0, a], y in [0, b].
        Q4:  N1 = (a-x)(b-y)/ab,  N2 = x(b-y)/ab,  N3 = xy/ab,  N4 = y(a-x)/ab   (2.21)
        T(x, y) = sum N_i T_i = {N}{T}^T                                          (2.22)
        gradient = {d}^T{N}{T}^T,  flux q = -[E] gradient                         (2.33)

Run
    python fe_shape_functions.py
        prints Activities 4 and 5 (a = 2, b = 1, P = (1.5, 0.3)) and the checks,
        and, if matplotlib is installed, saves maps of N1...N4 and N1...N8.

Use in your own work
    from fe_shape_functions import shape_q4, dshape_q4, interpolate, flux
    N = shape_q4(a, b, x, y)             # x, y LOCAL to the element
    T = interpolate(N, [T1, T2, T3, T4])

    For a point given in GLOBAL coordinates, find the element first and subtract
    the coordinates of its local node 1: x_loc = x - x1, y_loc = y - y1.

Requires Python 3.8+ and numpy; matplotlib only for the plots.
Course SEAA 4243, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
Code: MIT licence.
"""
import numpy as np


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q4: bilinear element, text (2.21) and (2.33)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def shape_q4(a, b, x, y):
    """N1..N4 at the local point (x, y) of an a x b element. Returns an array of 4."""
    return np.array([(a - x) * (b - y), x * (b - y), x * y, y * (a - x)], dtype=float) / (a * b)


def dshape_q4(a, b, x, y):
    """{d}^T{N}: 2 x 4 array, row 0 = dN_i/dx, row 1 = dN_i/dy, at local (x, y)."""
    return np.array([[-(b - y), (b - y), y, -y],
                     [-(a - x), -x, x, (a - x)]], dtype=float) / (a * b)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q8: serendipity element, text Sec. 2.2.1, evaluated through xi = 2x/a - 1, eta = 2y/b - 1
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_CX = [-1, 1, 1, -1]
_CY = [-1, -1, 1, 1]


def shape_q8(a, b, x, y):
    """N1..N8 at the local point (x, y). Corners 1-4, mid-sides 5 (bottom), 6 (right), 7 (top), 8 (left)."""
    xi, eta = 2 * x / a - 1, 2 * y / b - 1
    N = np.zeros(8)
    for i in range(4):
        N[i] = 0.25 * (1 + _CX[i] * xi) * (1 + _CY[i] * eta) * (_CX[i] * xi + _CY[i] * eta - 1)
    N[4] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 - eta)
    N[5] = 0.5 * (1 + xi) * (1 - eta ** 2)
    N[6] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 + eta)
    N[7] = 0.5 * (1 - xi) * (1 - eta ** 2)
    return N


def dshape_q8(a, b, x, y):
    """2 x 8 array of dN_i/dx and dN_i/dy at local (x, y) (chain rule: d/dx = (2/a) d/dxi)."""
    xi, eta = 2 * x / a - 1, 2 * y / b - 1
    dxi, deta = np.zeros(8), np.zeros(8)
    for i in range(4):
        dxi[i] = 0.25 * _CX[i] * (1 + _CY[i] * eta) * (2 * _CX[i] * xi + _CY[i] * eta)
        deta[i] = 0.25 * _CY[i] * (1 + _CX[i] * xi) * (_CX[i] * xi + 2 * _CY[i] * eta)
    dxi[4], deta[4] = -xi * (1 - eta), -0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)
    dxi[5], deta[5] = 0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 + xi)
    dxi[6], deta[6] = -xi * (1 + eta), 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)
    dxi[7], deta[7] = -0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 - xi)
    return np.vstack([dxi * 2 / a, deta * 2 / b])


def node_coords(a, b, nen=4):
    """Local coordinates of the element's nodes, in node order."""
    xy = [(0, 0), (a, 0), (a, b), (0, b), (a / 2, 0), (a, b / 2), (a / 2, b), (0, b / 2)]
    return np.array(xy[:nen], dtype=float)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Field at a point
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def interpolate(N, nodal_values):
    """T(x, y) = sum N_i T_i."""
    return float(np.dot(N, nodal_values))


def gradient(dN, nodal_values):
    """(dT/dx, dT/dy) = {d}^T{N}{T}^T."""
    return dN @ np.asarray(nodal_values, dtype=float)


def flux(dN, nodal_values, kx, ky=None):
    """Fourier's law: (qx, qy) = -(kx dT/dx, ky dT/dy). Heat flows from hot to cold."""
    ky = kx if ky is None else ky
    g = gradient(dN, nodal_values)
    return np.array([-kx * g[0], -ky * g[1]])


def check(a, b, nen=4, tol=1e-12):
    """The two properties every set of shape functions must pass.
    Kronecker delta: N_i = 1 at node i and 0 at the others. Partition of unity: sum N_i = 1."""
    f = shape_q4 if nen == 4 else shape_q8
    M = np.array([f(a, b, x, y) for x, y in node_coords(a, b, nen)])
    kron = np.allclose(M, np.eye(nen), atol=tol)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    pts = rng.random((50, 2)) * [a, b]
    pou = np.allclose([f(a, b, x, y).sum() for x, y in pts], 1.0, atol=tol)
    return kron, pou


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plots (optional): one colour map per shape function, shared limits
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def plot_shape_functions(a, b, nen=4, filename=None):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    except ImportError:
        print("matplotlib is not installed: skipping the plot")
        return None
    f = shape_q4 if nen == 4 else shape_q8
    xs, ys = np.linspace(0, a, 81), np.linspace(0, b, 41)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    lo, hi = (0.0, 1.0) if nen == 4 else (-0.25, 1.0)
    cols = 4
    rows = nen // cols
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(rows, cols, figsize=(3.2 * cols, 2.0 * rows * max(b / a, 0.5) + 0.8), squeeze=False)
    xy = node_coords(a, b, nen)
    for i in range(nen):
        ax = axs[i // cols][i % cols]
        Z = np.vectorize(lambda x, y: f(a, b, x, y)[i])(X, Y)
        cf = ax.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=np.linspace(lo, hi, 21), cmap="jet", vmin=lo, vmax=hi)
        ax.contour(X, Y, Z, levels=[0.0], colors="k", linewidths=0.8)
        ax.plot(xy[:, 0], xy[:, 1], "ko", ms=4)
        ax.plot(*xy[i], "wo", ms=7, mec="k")
        ax.set_title(f"N{i + 1}")
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
        ax.set_xticks([0, a]); ax.set_yticks([0, b])
    fig.colorbar(cf, ax=axs, shrink=0.8, label="N_i (black line: N_i = 0)")
    filename = filename or f"shape_functions_q{nen}.png"
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", filename)
    return filename


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Course example: Activities 4 and 5 (a = 2 m, b = 1 m, P = (1.5, 0.3) m)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True)
    a, b = 2.0, 1.0
    x, y = 1.5, 0.3
    T = [100.0, 140.0, 160.0, 120.0]
    k = 2.0

    N = shape_q4(a, b, x, y)
    print("Q4 element a = 2 m, b = 1 m, point (1.5, 0.3) m")
    print("  N1..N4      =", N, "  (expected 0.175 0.525 0.225 0.075)")
    print("  sum N_i     =", round(N.sum(), 12))
    print("  T           =", round(interpolate(N, T), 4), "K  (expected 136.0)")
    dN = dshape_q4(a, b, x, y)
    print("  dN/dx       =", dN[0], "  (expected -0.35 0.35 0.15 -0.15)")
    print("  gradient    =", gradient(dN, T), "K/m  (expected 20 20)")
    print("  flux, k = 2 =", flux(dN, T, k), "W/m2 (expected -40 -40)")
    print("  checks (Kronecker, partition of unity):", check(a, b, 4))

    N8 = shape_q8(a, b, a / 2, b / 2)
    print("\nQ8 element at the centre: N1..N8 =", N8)
    print("  corner functions are -0.25 there; sum =", round(N8.sum(), 12))
    print("  checks (Kronecker, partition of unity):", check(a, b, 8))

    plot_shape_functions(a, b, 4)
    plot_shape_functions(a, b, 8)

Not counted toward progress.Tidak dikira dalam kemajuan.

field problemAn unknown defined at every point of a region, such as T(x, y), rather than at a few discrete locations.Unknown yang wujud pada setiap titik dalam satu kawasan, seperti T(x, y), bukannya pada beberapa lokasi diskret sahaja.
scalar field · vector fieldOne number per point (temperature) versus two or more per point (displacement u, v).Satu nombor setiap titik (temperature) berbanding dua atau lebih setiap titik (displacement u, v).
heat flux qEnergy crossing a unit area per unit time, W m−2; a vector with components qx, qy.Tenaga yang melintasi unit luas per unit masa, W m−2; satu vector dengan komponen qx, qy.
Fourier’s lawq = −k ∇T: flux is proportional to the temperature gradient and points from hot to cold.q = −k ∇T: flux berkadar dengan temperature gradient dan menghala dari panas ke sejuk.
conductivity kMaterial property, W m−1 K−1; [E] = diag(kx, ky) for an orthotropic material.Sifat bahan, W m−1 K−1; [E] = diag(kx, ky) bagi bahan orthotropic.
heat generation qhHeat produced per unit volume, W m−3, for example by cement hydration.Haba dihasilkan per unit isi padu, W m−3, contohnya oleh hydration simen.
steady stateNothing changes with time: ∂T/∂t = 0, so the stored-energy term disappears.Tiada yang berubah dengan masa: ∂T/∂t = 0, jadi term tenaga tersimpan hilang.
Poisson · LaplaceSpecial cases of (2.11): constant isotropic k gives Poisson’s equation; no source gives Laplace’s equation.Kes khas (2.11): k constant dan isotropic memberi Poisson’s equation; tanpa source memberi Laplace’s equation.
boundary conditionWhat is specified on the edge of the domain: the temperature or the flux. Needed on every part of the boundary.Apa yang ditetapkan pada tepi domain: temperature atau flux. Diperlukan pada setiap bahagian sempadan.
Dirichlet · essentialA known value of the unknown field on the edge, T = T̄. Imposed on the assembled equations.Nilai yang diketahui bagi field pada tepi, T = T̄. Dikenakan pada assembled equation.
Neumann · naturalA known flux on the edge, qb, positive inward. Appears by itself through the integration by parts.Flux yang diketahui pada tepi, qb, positif ke dalam. Muncul dengan sendiri melalui integration by parts.
outward normal nUnit vector pointing out of the domain at an edge; on a rectangle (±1, 0) or (0, ±1).Unit vector yang menghala keluar dari domain pada satu tepi; pada segi empat tepat (±1, 0) atau (0, ±1).
insulated edgeA natural condition with qb = 0. Requires no action in the finite element model.Natural condition dengan qb = 0. Tidak memerlukan apa-apa tindakan dalam model finite element.
well-posedEvery edge has a condition and the temperature level is fixed somewhere, so the solution is unique.Setiap tepi ada condition dan paras temperature ditetapkan di suatu tempat, jadi penyelesaiannya unik.
element · nodeA small region (here a rectangle a × b) and the points on it where the unknowns live.Kawasan kecil (di sini segi empat tepat a × b) dan titik-titik padanya tempat unknown berada.
degree of freedomOne unknown of the discrete system; one temperature per node for conduction.Satu unknown dalam sistem diskret; satu temperature setiap node bagi conduction.
shape function NiThe function of position that multiplies nodal value i in the interpolation T = Σ Ni T̂i.Fungsi kedudukan yang mendarab nilai node i dalam interpolation T = Σ Ni T̂i.
bilinearLinear in x and in y separately, with an xy term: the four-node element’s polynomial (2.17).Linear dalam x dan dalam y secara berasingan, dengan term xy: polynomial four-node element (2.17).
Kronecker deltaNi = 1 at its own node and 0 at the others; so the nodal unknowns are nodal temperatures.Ni = 1 pada node sendiri dan 0 pada node lain; jadi nodal unknown ialah temperature pada node.
partition of unityΣ Ni = 1 at every point; a uniform field is reproduced exactly.Σ Ni = 1 pada setiap titik; field yang seragam dihasilkan semula dengan tepat.
C0 continuityT is continuous across element edges but its derivative generally jumps.T continuous merentasi tepi element tetapi derivative-nya biasanya melompat.
gradient matrix {∂}ᵀ{N}The 2 × 4 matrix of shape-function derivatives; gradient = {∂}ᵀ{N}{T̂}ᵀ.Matrix 2 × 4 bagi derivative shape function; gradient = {∂}ᵀ{N}{T̂}ᵀ.
conductance matrix [k]The element matrix of Part 2, [k] = ∫∫{N}ᵀ{∂}[E]{∂}ᵀ{N} dy dx; the heat analogue of stiffness.Matrix element dalam Part 2, [k] = ∫∫{N}ᵀ{∂}[E]{∂}ᵀ{N} dy dx; analog haba bagi stiffness.
assembly · connectivityAdding element matrices into the global system using each element’s list of global node numbers.Menambah matrix element ke dalam sistem global menggunakan senarai nombor node global setiap element.
